description: Safe Solidity controls used to measure detector false positives outside the positive ground-truth cases.

controls.rationale: The value call is protected by a nonReentrant modifier.
Structured storage exists without any delegatecall execution path.
The contract has an ordinary close flag and no selfdestruct opcode.
The externally callable mint path enforces onlyOwner authorization.
Authorization compares msg.sender and never reads tx.origin.
The callback-sensitive entry point is protected by nonReentrant.
The mapping and struct layout are present, but delegatecall is absent.
The low-level value call checks its success return value.
Distribution processes one explicitly selected recipient per call.
The timing gate uses block.number rather than block.timestamp.
